submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 5mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.2% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This material demonstrates superior performance compared to F1 (3.9% at 5mm) and F3 (5.1% at 5mm). The thickness optimization study confirmed that 5mm provides the optimal balance, with performance degrading at both smaller (3.58% at 2mm) and larger (4.254% at 10mm) thicknesses. All dose rate constraints are satisfied, making this the ideal choice for achieving the best possible energy resolution while meeting all safety and operational requirements.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 at 5mm thickness achieves 3.2% energy resolution, which is the best among all tested configurations (F1: 3.9%, F3: 5.1% at 5mm baseline; F2 ranges from 3.2% to 4.254% across 2-10mm thickness range)

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 µSv/h
requirements.evidence: All three materials including F2 satisfy the dose constraint: F2_satisfies_dose_constraint = 1, dose_constraint_satisfied = 1
